definition.systemPrompt:
Create a document-grounded assistant that answers questions about shift swaps, leave requests, travel reimbursement, and payroll appeals in plain, friendly English. Cite the relevant handbook or expenses notice.
Audience: North Pier shore staff. Tone: friendly. Quote only verified passages with source IDs. Ask for clarification when the topic is missing. Refuse unsupported requests.

chunks.text: Travel reimbursement deadline: File travel reimbursement within 14 calendar days after return.
Travel reimbursement evidence: Attach the itemized receipt and approved trip reference.
Local rail fare: Claim the standard class ticket price for approved journeys.
Taxi approval: Obtain written supervisor approval before booking a taxi.
Meal allowance: The overnight meal allowance is 28 credits per person.
Expense correction: Reopen a returned claim within five working days.
Mileage rate: Approved private vehicle travel earns 0.42 credits per kilometer.
Missing receipt: Attach a signed loss declaration to the expense claim.
Shift swap notice: Submit swap requests at least 36 hours before the affected shift.
Shift swap approval: Both employees and the roster supervisor must confirm in the roster portal.
Annual leave notice: File annual leave requests at least 10 calendar days before departure.
Annual leave approver: The department lead approves annual leave in the leave portal.
Emergency leave contact: Call the duty coordinator before the scheduled shift begins.
Shift swap record: Keep the roster portal confirmation until the following payroll cycle closes.
Training leave allowance: Staff may request two paid training days each calendar year.
Returning from leave: Confirm the next rostered shift with the duty coordinator.
